#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

readonly STATE_DIR=/var/lib/etc-integrity
readonly BASELINE="${STATE_DIR}/etc.baseline"
readonly CREATED="${STATE_DIR}/created_at"

umask 077

usage() {
    printf 'Usage: %s {init|check|status}\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
    exit 2
}

require_root() {
    if [ "${EUID}" -ne 0 ]; then
        printf 'ERROR: must be run as root\n' >&2
        exit 2
    fi
}

snapshot() {
    local path type digest mode uid gid size
    while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
        if [ -L "${path}" ]; then
            type=l
            digest=$(readlink -- "${path}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
        elif [ -f "${path}" ]; then
            type=f
            digest=$(sha256sum -- "${path}" | awk '{print $1}')
        else
            continue
        fi
        read -r mode uid gid size < <(stat -c '%a %u %g %s' -- "${path}")
        printf '%q\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n'             "${path}" "${type}" "${mode}" "${uid}" "${gid}" "${size}" "${digest}"
    done < <(find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l \) -print0 | sort -z)
}

init_baseline() {
    local tmp count
    require_root
    install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "${STATE_DIR}"
    tmp=$(mktemp "${STATE_DIR}/.baseline.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f -- "${tmp}"' EXIT
    snapshot > "${tmp}"
    chmod 0600 "${tmp}"
    chown root:root "${tmp}"
    mv -f -- "${tmp}" "${BASELINE}"
    date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > "${CREATED}"
    chmod 0600 "${CREATED}"
    chown root:root "${CREATED}"
    count=$(wc -l < "${BASELINE}")
    printf 'BASELINE_CREATED path=/etc entries=%s created=%s database=%s\n'         "${count}" "$(cat "${CREATED}")" "${BASELINE}"
    trap - EXIT
}

check_baseline() {
    local tmp line key record changed added removed
    require_root
    if [ ! -r "${BASELINE}" ]; then
        printf 'ERROR: baseline not found: %s (run init first)\n' "${BASELINE}" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    tmp=$(mktemp "${STATE_DIR}/.check.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f -- "${tmp}"' EXIT
    snapshot > "${tmp}"

    declare -A old=()
    declare -A new=()
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        key=${line%%$'\t'*}
        record=${line#*$'\t'}
        old["${key}"]="${record}"
    done < "${BASELINE}"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        key=${line%%$'\t'*}
        record=${line#*$'\t'}
        new["${key}"]="${record}"
    done < "${tmp}"

    changed=0
    added=0
    removed=0
    for key in "${!new[@]}"; do
        if [ -z "${old[${key}]+present}" ]; then
            printf 'ADDED %s new=%s\n' "${key}" "${new[${key}]}"
            added=$((added + 1))
        elif [ "${old[${key}]}" != "${new[${key}]}" ]; then
            printf 'CHANGED %s old=%s new=%s\n'                 "${key}" "${old[${key}]}" "${new[${key}]}"
            changed=$((changed + 1))
        fi
    done
    for key in "${!old[@]}"; do
        if [ -z "${new[${key}]+present}" ]; then
            printf 'REMOVED %s old=%s\n' "${key}" "${old[${key}]}"
            removed=$((removed + 1))
        fi
    done

    if [ "${added}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${changed}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${removed}" -eq 0 ]; then
        printf 'INTEGRITY_OK path=/etc entries=%s baseline_created=%s\n'             "$(wc -l < "${BASELINE}")" "$(cat "${CREATED}" 2>/dev/null || printf unknown)"
        exit 0
    fi
    printf 'INTEGRITY_ALERT path=/etc added=%s changed=%s removed=%s\n'         "${added}" "${changed}" "${removed}"
    exit 1
}

show_status() {
    if [ ! -r "${BASELINE}" ]; then
        printf 'NO_BASELINE path=/etc database=%s\n' "${BASELINE}"
        exit 1
    fi
    printf 'BASELINE_PRESENT path=/etc entries=%s created=%s database=%s\n'         "$(wc -l < "${BASELINE}")" "$(cat "${CREATED}" 2>/dev/null || printf unknown)" "${BASELINE}"
}

case "${1:-}" in
    init) init_baseline ;;
    check) check_baseline ;;
    status) show_status ;;
    *) usage ;;
esac
